title: Digital block injection sites
view: Two panels. Left: the back of a right hand, fingers up, thumb on the left. Right: the middle finger cut at its base (the dashed line), back of the finger at the top, thumb side on the left.
teachingPoint: Enter at the dorsolateral base of the digit on each side. From one entry the needle runs down the side of the bone past the dorsal nerve toward the volar bundle, so one entry can reach both branches on that side.
claims: Left: back of a right hand, fingers up, thumb on the left. Painted by Gemini from the code layout; markings drawn in code. Red dots: needle entries at the dorsolateral base of the middle finger, at the level of the webs. Dashed line: the section.
Right: the finger base in section, same way round. Proximal phalanx in the middle; extensor mechanism on its back; flexor tendons (FDS volar to FDP) in their sheath on its front.
A ring round the cut on the finger, a frame round the section, and two lines joining them mark the right panel as the magnified cut of the left.
Two volar (proper palmar) digital nerves with their arteries at the volar-lateral corners, the nerve on the volar side of the artery; two small dorsal digital nerves at the dorsolateral corners.
Each needle enters at the dorsolateral corner and passes down the side of the bone, ending beside the volar bundle, not in it. Teal: the deposits beside the dorsal nerve and beside the volar bundle.
Two labels: Dorsal digital nerve, Volar digital nerve.
